agent-productization.description: Productize local AI agent and RAG demos. Use for LangChain, LangGraph, AgentScope, Eino, CrewAI, browser agents, and agent web apps.

anycap-cli.description: Use AnyCap CLI for image, video, music, media analysis, web search or crawl, Drive links, hosted pages, authentication, and configuration.

browse.description: Use gstack’s headless browser for web QA: navigate, interact, inspect console or network, capture screenshots, and verify page state.

brief-to-tasks.description: Turn a design brief into an ordered Markdown checklist of independently buildable vertical slices. Use for implementation task breakdowns.

careful.description: Warn before destructive shell, database, Git, cloud, or filesystem operations. Use when commands could delete data or rewrite history.

chatgpt-apps.description: Build ChatGPT Apps SDK projects with MCP servers and widget UIs. Use for tools, resources, bridge APIs, metadata, CSP, and scaffolds.

cli-creator.description: Build Codex CLIs from APIs, OpenAPI specs, SDKs, curl, web apps, or scripts, with stable JSON output, auth, and companion Skills.

cli-tooling-inventory.description: Audit and verify local CLI/MCP setup. Use for availability, auth, PATH, architecture, provider logins, tool selection, and Skill coverage.

configure-custom-domain.description: Configure and verify custom domains for Vercel apps with Aliyun DNS. Use for DNS records, HTTPS, routing, aliases, and domain docs.

deploy-to-vercel.description: Deploy apps and websites to Vercel. Use for preview or production deployments and requests to push an app live and return its URL.

design-review.description: Review a built UI against its brief and codebase. Use for design critique, visual hierarchy, consistency, responsiveness, and accessibility.

gh-fix-ci.description: Diagnose failing GitHub Actions PR checks with gh. Summarize logs, propose a fix, and implement only after explicit approval.

gstack-upgrade.description: Upgrade the installed gstack safely. Use to detect install mode, update gstack, validate the result, and summarize release changes.

figma-implement-design.description: Implement production UI from Figma with 1:1 fidelity. Use for Figma URLs, design-to-code, components, and matching existing design specs.

fixing-accessibility.description: Audit and fix web accessibility. Use for ARIA, keyboard navigation, focus, contrast, forms, dialogs, interactive controls, and WCAG reviews.

fixing-metadata.description: Audit and fix web metadata. Use for titles, canonical URLs, Open Graph, social cards, favicons, JSON-LD, and robots directives.

find-bugs.description: Review current branch changes for correctness bugs, security vulnerabilities, regressions, and missing tests. Use for code review or audits.

frontend-design.description: Build distinctive production web interfaces. Use for frontend components, pages, and apps needing polished, non-generic visual design.

investigate.description: Investigate bugs and failures through reproduction, evidence, hypotheses, root cause, minimal fixes, and verification. Use before fixing.

impeccable.description: Create polished, distinctive web interfaces. Use craft to build, teach for design context, or extract for reusable components and tokens.

kevinten10-supabase.description: Use Kevin’s existing Supabase project for demos, migrations, schemas, and Vercel environment setup; do not create redundant demo projects.

land-and-deploy.description: Merge a PR, wait for CI and deployment, then verify production health. Use for land, merge, deploy, or production verification requests.

mcp-server-release.description: Validate and release MCP servers under $HOME/projects/mcp. Use for packaging, docs, transports, Inspector checks, and publishing.

media-production-pipeline.description: Plan local image, video, audio, subtitle, voice, presentation, 3D, and social-publishing workflows across media tools and MCP servers.

modern-python.description: Set up or modernize Python with uv, Ruff, and ty. Use for new projects, standalone scripts, or pip, Poetry, mypy, and Black migrations.

open-gstack-browser.description: Launch the visible GStack Browser with its AI sidebar. Use when asked to open or control Chrome, a real browser, or the gstack browser.

pdf.description: Read, create, or review PDFs where rendering matters. Use visual checks and Python PDF tools for extraction, editing, and generation.

playwright.description: Automate a real browser with playwright-cli. Use for navigation, forms, screenshots, extraction, and terminal-driven UI-flow debugging.

repo-readme-release.description: Prepare repositories for public release. Use for README, install commands, examples, privacy notes, validation, and push readiness.

review.description: Review a PR diff before landing for correctness, SQL safety, trust boundaries, conditional side effects, regressions, and missing tests.

security-best-practices.description: Review Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Go for secure defaults and security best practices. Use only when explicitly requested.

screenshot.description: Capture desktop or system screenshots by screen, window, or region. Use when explicit screenshot requests need OS-level capture.

vercel-composition-patterns.description: Apply scalable React composition. Use for boolean prop proliferation, compound components, render props, context, and reusable APIs.

vercel-react-best-practices.description: Apply Vercel React and Next.js performance guidance. Use for components, data fetching, rendering, bundles, and performance refactors.

web-design-guidelines.description: Apply web design, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance guidelines. Use when building or reviewing HTML, CSS, and web components.

wrangler.description: Use Wrangler for Cloudflare Workers, KV, R2, D1, Queues, Workflows, AI, and related services. Load before running Wrangler commands.
